reason: Conversation 1 gathers useful details (when it trips, which zone, smell) and gives clear safety advice to isolate the hob and get an engineer to test insulation. It overstates the diagnosis, claiming earth leakage in a failing coil or power module as 'likely', and it never asks which switch trips. Conversation 2 gives only a generic stop-using message with no questions and no diagnostic value. It also tells the user to 'leave the appliance unplugged' for a built-in hob and says 'from what you have checked' when nothing has been checked. Conversation 1 is more useful despite its overconfidence.
